title: Late-Posting Supplement on Residential Natural Gas Supply Sign-Up Credits
content:
**Standard.** When a Residential Natural Gas Supply sign-up credit is posted, the late-posting supplement depends on the calendar days from the service start date to the posting date: 10.00 when they are 540 or more, 5.00 when they are at least 180 but fewer than 540, and no supplement when they are fewer than 180. The supplement, in US dollars, is added to the sign-up credit owed.

The record read is the service start date on the agreement; the other end of the span is the day the credit is posted.

| Calendar days from the service start date to the posting date | Late-posting supplement (USD) |
|---|---|
| 540 or more | 10.00 |
| 180 to 539 | 5.00 |
| fewer than 180 | none |

### Edges (hypothetical spans)

540 days earns 10.00 and 539 days earns 5.00; 180 days earns 5.00 and 179 days earns none.
